SMTO-UI-0007 — A value in this form isn't in the right format

GUID: 2cfb6614-49e8-4b18-9303-4fc93f7985d3
Slug: ui-form-invalid
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • SMTO found a value in a form that it couldn't accept, so that form wasn't saved. This message doesn't say which field it was.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look through the form for a field outlined or marked with a message, and read the hint or limits shown beside it. This message doesn't name the field, but the form usually marks the one it rejected.
  2. Change that value to match the hint, for example a plain number, a whole number, or a value within the allowed range, then save. Sending the same value again will be rejected again, so it has to change first.
  3. If no field is marked, refresh the browser page, make your change again, and save. Refreshing loads the current form and its current checks, which will point to the exact field if one is still wrong.

What success looks like

  • The form saves and no field shows an error message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the name of the screen you were using, to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A legacy UI error alias reported that a local form value did not match its supported format; no current code path raises it directly, so the original field and validation are not identified.

What this means

  • This retained alias describes an invalid local form value without a current direct field-specific producer. No direct current emitter for this retained alias was found. Inspect the original occurrence and current control state before assuming a particular validation ran or a submission was prevented.

Why this can happen

  • This retained alias describes an invalid local form value without a current direct field-specific producer.

How to diagnose it

  • Identify the original form, field and installed version before recommending a replacement value.

How to fix it

  • This is a retained alias (ui_form_invalid) with no current direct emitter; resolve_error_ref in src/error_catalog/resolver.py maps it. Inspect the original occurrence's facts and the form's current field-level validation messages rather than assuming which check ran or whether submission was blocked.
  • Correct the indicated field using the form’s documented format and limits.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Current field-specific validation accepts the intended supported format.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • No direct current emitter for this retained alias was found. Inspect the original occurrence and current control state before assuming a particular validation ran or a submission was prevented.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
